J1.mpn: PCB termination; 2 x 1.5 mm2 to XT60 (wall)
J1.note: Pack 4S: XT60 male in the enclosure wall -> 2 x 1.5 mm2 -> J1 with strain-relief anchor 12.5 mm (footprint of P02 R3 J1).

Q9.note: Reverse-polarity switch, back-to-back with Q1 (sources at SW_COM). Drain at the pack: correct polarity -> body diode conducts, gate pulled to GND -> on; reversed pack -> VGS = 0, body diode blocks. No heatsink: 0.37 W at 3.5 A.

D10.note: Clamp VSG of Q9 <= 15 V (K = source).

C1.note: Local reservoir at SW_COM (P01 C1 at VS).

Q1.note: Main switch (P01 Q1). Drain now to VSW directly (P01: via LK1 to VPROT). No heatsink: 0.37 W at 3.5 A.

C5.note: Miller capacitor GATE-VSW (P01: GATE-VPROT); sets VSW slew ~12 V/ms with R21. Never above 22 nF (P01 R1 hot-plug blocker).

C6.note: G-S capacitor; keeps VSG <= 0.3 V at hot plug (C5/(C5+C6)).

Q2.note: Fast turn-off: pulls GATE to SW_COM through R27 when ENABLE is lost (P01 Q2).

R23.note: R4 change (user decision 29.09.2026): P01 2K2/2W -> 22K/0.5W. Q2 is on while ENABLE is low; static loss 13 mW instead of 128 mW. Turn-off delay grows (docs/OBLICZENIA-R4.md); no OVP needs speed on a 4S pack.

Q4.note: Holds Q2 off while ENABLE is high. onsemi 2N5401YBU E-B-C; never the -C bondout (P01 R3 note).

D3.note: Unidirectional TVS on VSW (VWM 18 V >= 16.8 V). Clamps motor-wiring transients; a pack above ~20 V (VBR min) makes it conduct.

C3.note: VSW reservoir (spec: <= 100 uF). Counts to the 220 uF budget together with VLOG caps and P07 input (docs/OBLICZENIA-R4.md).

F1.note: F_M (D-04): automotive MINI blade 5 A, 32 VDC, in a PCB holder. VMOTOR <= 3.5 A continuous (firmware), OC 4 A.

J2.note: P07 plug as R3. VMOTOR is now the switched pack (12-16.8 V) behind F1.

D1.note: OR of VSW (A1, D1a) and C_H (A2, D1b) into VLOG; K+tab = VLOG. Never a common-anode variant.

R40.note: R_ch: charges C_H, tau 48 ms, peak 0.76 A, 0.31 J per charge. Must be a fusible (flameproof) type that survives the charge pulse; a shorted C_H would dissipate 12.8 W here. PR02 footprint (body 2 W class).

D2.note: Charge diode of C_H; anodes 1+3 tied on the PCB, K+tab = HOLD_C. Keeps C_H out of VSW, P07 and a VSW short.

C12.mpn: EEUFR1V222 (16x25, P7.5) or equivalent low-ESR 105 C
C12.note: C_H hold-up (user decision 29.09.2026). 16 x 25 mm; D12.5 x 35 mm variants need another footprint.

R41.note: C_H bleeder, 28 mW at 16.8 V, tau 22 s.

C20.note: VLOG bus at D1 cathode (R3 C4).

D11.note: V_CTRL = SW_COM OR VLOG: AUX5 lasts through hold-up.

R1.note: P01: 150R/2W against car surges. Pack has none: 47R/0.5W keeps AUX5 regulating down to VLOG ~6.5 V (9 mA).

U1.note: AUX5 for comparator, TL431, OK pull-up.

R2.note: ESR for LM2936 output stability (P01 R2).

R5.note: R_T1: limits current if the PWR wire shorts to GND (16.8 mA, 0.28 W). Part of the UVLO top branch.

J14.mpn: PCB termination; 2 x AWG22 to panel switch
J14.note: Panel switch in the UVLO top branch (Z-04): closed = on; open or broken wire = off. ~0.3 mA, signal-grade switch.

C13.note: Filter before R12 (tau ~98 us), not on the feedback node (R3 lesson).

R12.note: R_iso: separates C13 from the hysteresis feedback.

U2.note: B: UVLO (P01 layout: 5=+ 6=REF 7=OK). A: PFAIL_N buffer of OK (3 = OK x 0.6, 2 = REF). Deviation from literal D-06 wording: A follows OK itself, so PFAIL_N can never disagree with the switch state (see docs/OBLICZENIA-R4.md).

R6.note: OK divider for U2A: 0.6 x OK.

U4.note: POR of OK: holds OK low until AUX5 > 4.5 V + reset timeout (P01 U4).

R36.note: PFAIL_N pull-up to local 3V3_IO (low whenever 3V3_IO is absent).

J16.mpn: PCB termination; 2 x AWG28 to P03
J16.note: D-02: new P03 input (1k series, 10k pull-up to 3V3_CORE on P03).

R30.note: Fed from J13.1 (3V3 returned by P04), not from local 3V3_IO: SAFE_N = L whenever P04 is powered and ENABLE is absent (P01 behaviour).

J13.mpn: PCB termination; H_PG 6 x AWG22 -> Mini-Fit 6p 39-01-2060
J13.note: Moved from P01 J5; P04 J7 unchanged. Pin 1 is the 3V3 supplied by P04 (named P04_3V3 here so it never merges with local 3V3_IO).

R29.note: LED PWR ~2 mA at 16.8 V; also bleeds VSW when Q1 is off.

LED1.note: Lit while Q1 is on (VSW present).

F2.note: D-04: automotive MINI 1 A, 32 VDC (R3: Schurter SPT T1A). <= 0.86 A at 7 V for the 6 W budget.

U6.note: 3V3_IO only; never tie to 3V3_CORE of P03.

U9.note: As R3 U5: 5 V RST to 3.3 V logic. Unused OE#=3V3_IO, inputs=GND.

C27.note: At adapter pins; C28 on the adapter itself.

C28.note: Fitted on the U9 adapter at IC pins 14 and 7 (as R3 C16).

U10.note: Gate A = PSU_OK (as R3). HOLD_READY gates of R3 removed: gates B-D inputs to GND, outputs open.

R44.note: PSU_OK low while U10 is unpowered.

J12.note: 6 x AWG28, 150 mm, IDC 6p KEY 5 at P04 J6 (as R3). Pin 3 = PFAIL_N (R3: HOLD_READY); NC on P04.

J15.note: D-01: one wire from the car battery + terminal in the engine bay, 0.5 A in-line fuse <= 10 cm from the terminal; NO ground wire.

R38.note: Limits TVS current; CH7 multiplier 6.0898 -> 6.1918 (+1.67 %, recalibrate).

J11.mpn: Molex Mini-Fit Jr 5566-02A vertical, Au (39-29-x02x, confirm)
J11.note: D-03: 2p instead of 14p; P05 J5 -> CH7 (VBAT of the car).

TP4.note: TP4: raw C_H (0.31 J max); use a DMM or a probe with a series resistor.
